What we fix

Two problems almost every North Texas homeowner has.

The sun

West-facing rooms you avoid every afternoon. Blinds that never open.

  • HeatRooms that stay hot and an AC that never stops running.
  • GlareCan't see the TV or your screen. Squinting at the kitchen table.
  • BrightnessHarsh light you shouldn't have to shut out with blinds.
  • UV & fadingFloors, furniture, rugs and art losing their color.

Privacy & security

Feel comfortable at home without closing yourself in.

  • Daytime privacyNeighbors can't see in. You can still see out.
  • Security filmHolds glass together and slows down forced entry.
  • InvisibleClear protection that doesn't change how your home looks.

Why CoolVu

Homes and businesses. Not cars.

Most tint shops do homes on the side. But home glass is different: dual-pane, low-E coatings, manufacturer warranties. The wrong film on the wrong glass can crack it or void your warranty, and you're the one who pays.

"If we don't do a great job for your home, nothing else matters. That's how we build this business." Mitchell Meyers, Owner

  1. We test your glass first

    Before we recommend anything, we find out exactly what type of glass you have. You can't improve something you haven't measured.

  2. Your glass warranty is covered

    We absorb the glass warranty and match your window seal warranties. You get peace of mind, not a gamble.

  3. Every major brand, plus our own

    We can install films from the top manufacturers, plus CoolVu films engineered specifically for homes. We pick what fits your problem, not what we have in stock.

  4. Local team, national backing

    Owned and run here, by people who know North Texas sun and HOA rules. Backed by a national brand for the best products, training and support.
